entries.text: Pray for me I keep getting spirit attacks and smarts
For smarts and other things

Prayer Request from David 10/5/2026:

Please pray for our ministry leaders, churches, and ministers.

So the gospel can spread and the good news of Jesus Christ be heard all over the world.

Also please pray for Alex, he is suffering from a stomach problem and need healing in Jesus' name.

Thank you Seed the Word

Prayer Request for Oksana 10/6/2026:

Oksana is the mom of Vitaliy, who is one of the very first people that appeared on my walk to encounter Jesus, or the Holy Spirit encountering me and his mom was at prayer tonight and she is having spiritual attacks that affect her physical health.

She describes it as sharp pain cutting her from within and it is actually a demonic oppression that needs to be rebuked but also need mercy from Jesus as it is not something we can help her with but only Jesus can take mercy on her from what came to my heart.

Please do pray for her.

She is a mom to our friend and someone's wife and a member of the body of Christ.

I want to pray for Ousman Darboe, and hes a guy asking for money for food, hes given me his name, and he has chatted with me. I want to pray he if he is a genuine believer he may find the food hes looking for.

Additionally, decernment for myself, because actually I still feel convicted to help.

I genuinely don't believe he's lying, then again, I have learned I can be quite gullible. So decernment that I might not be deceived.

I don't know if he's safe, but I want to send something small, I looked up the money for a meal there, if at a restaurant.

5 - 15 is enough for a meal there, and in the grand scheme of things not a big monetary loss, as I am going to be going back to work soon. And so if he isn't a believer, I am not giving him much, but for someone who genuinely needs it will genuinely help.

So yeah, prayers, and also decernment. Lastly, like reach out.

A man needs the counsel of others, to not fail. So I trust yall, what shall I do, how should I proceed

Allow the ministry to discuss this matter and determine if God will bless the finances of the ministry to give after prayer as appropriate and we are taught by Scripture

Any personal contributions you make cannot be made on behalf of the ministry and are solely your discretion to do with the finances as you please

I would caution you to have discernment in understanding if this will achieve greater good or evil long term for the non believers and their growth in faith with Jesus Christ versus single small contributions that may seem like they help now but will hurt them in the long term

Prayer Request for ministry 10/7/2026:

Everyone please pray for this ministry and our team leaders and ministry members.

I really need you all to lift each other in prayer for spiritual protection from the enemy.

Prayer for Fin 8/10/2026

 he is a brother in Christ, who lives in UK, hes having lots of pain in his back, additionally, he is probably lukewarm within his faith, so prayer he may be set on fire for Christ.

That he may spend time in the word, and do it consistently.

That he may pray for healing, he may restore his back / and arm, so he may proclaim all the good things God has done for him.

I am going to do Bible studies with him this morning, also the verse of the day, is this so this is the perfect opportunity to step in and help a brother in need!!! ❤️
My boss, allowed me to only work 3 days so I can have Sunday off, so I can go to Church, Praise GOD!!!
Hallelujah! Praise Jesus!

Prayer Request for trip 10/8/2026:

Our team just boarded the plane and are preparing for take off.

Please pray for our safe flight and may God bless you, we are praying also.
I will record one when I get home but I am praying for you 🙏

Prayer for Jules:

Strength, Vigilance, and be on guard from spiritual attacks. To be anchored in the word, filled with faith and equipped with it as her shield.
Prayer for safety as I am riding my bike today
Thank you Liam!

Hey y’all pray for my friend Justin @justinc87 , he just moved, I think from what I remember Texas or North Carolina, either way, pray he can find a job and find purpose in Jesus again, and some new friends!

Prayer for two young kids being baptized, that the Lord allows them to be reborn in water, that he blesses them and keeps them safe, and when they are of age they me be baptized in faith like me.

I know God saved me, and so I pray those young souls also may be committed to him. 🙏

Good morning fam!

I'm so excited to be posting today especially from a new place and praising God for all His rich blessings!

Praying for all of you today and here's the verse for the day:
Philippians 4:19 ESV 
[19] And my God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
I'm going to a pumpkin patch today and I hope to pass out our flyers to those who God is calling to join our ministry.
I love that ! Praying for your success!

As I was doing Bible studies, I had a brother in faith, walk up and ask if I was reading a Bible, I said yes, and proceeded to describe what I was doing openly in the break room, Got a knuckle bump from him, I didn't get his name, but when I see him again I will ask if hes interested in joining the ministry today is a great day!!!
Also free pie
His name is cion I am getting him connected to the group!!!
He's going to Denver but we might have a new member!!!

Prayer for Bakari: 

-that God supports his business ventures, and provides for his basic needs

-prayer he may seek after him so all his needs may be made complete.

-prayer the soles of his feet may harden (he wasn't wearing shoes/ socks, hes not homeless, just trying to harden his feet

-prayer for corrective surgery to heal
-Also gave him a gideon
Prayer he reads it and he starts going to church.
Good morning y’all ! I’m grateful for a new and sunny day today! Can’t wait for young adults tonight at 6:30pm 😁 so grateful for this ministry
Amen, I am excited too!!!
I got a prayer request for my Granny, but also for the extended fam as a whole for wisdom and decernment.
Jesus4Gino(I believe thats how its spelled)

Prayer for spiritual defense for me, so I may trust and take every thought captive for the Lord. That I may endure whatever is happening to me. That my faith would be made stronger.

I am starting my shift in like ~40 mins, and I don't feel the strength or will to do this, but I also know its written I shouldn't grow tired of doing good.

I know the enemy must submit to Jesus, and things will get better.

However, right now its really hard for me.

So I will take whatever prayers you can offer me. I need every one rn 🙏
We’re praying Liam 🙌🏻🙏🏻

I pray for strength in obedience, I pray for patience, I pray for fire 🔥 for Jesus, I pray for humility in us, friends ! Pray for our ministry that we may keep serving You and our cities for You! 🌆 May Jesus fill every corner of our lives, let us not be ashamed of our God in front of our lukewarm/un believers, I rebuke the denial of Jesus but to walk with confidence and faith, He is our strength, our source, our redeemer, Lord may we walk proudly knowing we are Yours and You are ours, and keep praying for the fruits of the Spirit to grow and for You to prune our dead and unfruitful parts of our lives. 

We love you Jesus. Amen

May we pray for what we need to pray for, and remember no prayer is too big or too much for our God, Lord You bear our burdens because you care for us, You want us to reach out to You for help, for everything, You want us to depend on You, how great is our God? How wonderful and loving is He? We give You all the glory and praise Jesus our Savior 🙏🏻💕
Amen! ✊

You didn’t just die to save us from our sins, You died so we can have a bridge to You, so You could come down to us and allow us to have a true relationship with You, and give us confidence that we can do all things through You who strengthens us. May we never forget this!!! Amen and amen and amen

Jesus thank you for all you do, for calling us to be Christians, for making us more then conquers and kings and queens. With a royal inheritance into your kingdom.

You met us in the mess, and made us into saints.

Praise you for all the good you gave done, and will do. I believe you will work all things for our good.

You gave us hope, a future in a kingdom of heaven. And promised whatever suffering now is incomparable to the glory ahead of us.

Let us walk by faith, and not by sight. Renew our strength when we grow tired.

This war was won, and is ours.

The gates of hell shall not prevail against us, against this ministry, against your church, your bride.

You love us, and there is hope.

Amen and Hallelujah.

Victory is yours

I didn't get the chance to say this but we got free cookies in the break room, 😋 God really helped me through the lows. 

It feels so good to be blessed

 Pray for strength and peace as she grieves the recent passing of her aunt.

We will be praying Ava, tonight we have prayer night at Maple Park Church and will be praying in unison for these things. If anyone else who can’t come has prayer requests, please put them down here !!!

I got called Christian boy by one of my coworkers whom I evangelised to before they worked at Costco, it makes me slightly happy my coworkers either openly acknowledge my faith, and or suggest I avoid doing things because it wouldn't be beneficial to my faith, for example in the breakroom they were playing horror movies, and I was told it might be better to avoid what I watch, what I see. Thats good because I am clearly demonstrating what it means to be set apart and to lead by example. Praise God.
Also members recognize me from when I evangelized in the summer and they point and I just wave with a smile. Its hilarious some days 🤣 their mouths drop open

Prayer for Chelsea, she is a woman on my bus who draws characters and makes OCs, we talked about hers and I also got inspiration to redesign the chest for my own.

She is interested in helluva boss, and Hazbin hotel, so she's definitely not Christian and realized going for the route of directly pointing out her way of life and her intrests are demonic wouldn't work.

I did however describe the fates of the characters in those shows and what happens actually to them when they do what they do.

(My sister watched the shows so I have basic knowledge on each of the demons)

Anyway she did get uncomfortable, hopefully that will get her to question where she stands in reguard to faith.

However what I did so was end on a positive term, and offered a Bible, and she took it surprisingly.

So prayers she reads it, and starts the path of turning away from her life.

Also prayed over her and laid hands so if any demons are inside they would be cast out.

Prayers she seeks Jesus, Jesus gibes her the spirit and starts the process of growth in her life.
I showed care and interest in her, and her life, and so hopefully she can see that I genuinely am seeking the best for her wellbeing and she can turn away from her own life.
